name: Vincent
source:
Vince is one of the contestants of America's Most Eligible. He is first seen in Book 1, Chapter 19. 

Although much of his personality is second-hand information from [url=/c86791/]Adam McIntyre[/url], it appears that he is a charming yet selfish and disloyal person given that he betrayed Adam at the end of Season 9. [url=/c86789/]Jen Espinoza[/url] mentions that his personality is much more hostile when the cameras are off, once threatening to get her fired because he felt she was asking him too many questions during his confessional. He enjoys riling up the other contestants, including Adam and [url=/c86790/]Mackenzie Harris[/url], through berating and insults. In a premium scene in All-Stars Chapter 14, he says he would rather be feared than loved. He also believes he is God's gift to humanity. 

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Vince]Wiki[/url]]
